m = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model')

import json, os, sys

errors = []

# 1. Check all required paths exist
paths = {
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/config.json": "configured model config",
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/model.safetensors": "configured model weights",
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/tokenizer.json": "tokenizer",
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/tokenizer_config.json": "tokenizer config",
    "/app/merged_model/config.json": "merged model config",
    "/app/merged_model/model.safetensors": "merged model weights",
    "/app/merged_model/tokenizer.json": "merged tokenizer",
    "/app/merged_model/tokenizer_config.json": "merged tokenizer config",
    "/app/detection_results.json": "detection results",
}
for p, desc in paths.items():
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        errors.append(f"MISSING: {desc} at {p}")
    else:
        print(f"  [OK] {desc}: {p}")

# 2. Check num_labels=20 in configured model
from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification
m_cfg = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base")
if m_cfg.config.num_labels != 20:
    errors.append(f"num_labels is {m_cfg.config.num_labels}, expected 20")
else:
    print(f"  [OK] num_labels = 20 (not default 2)")

# 3. Check merged model also has 20 labels
m_merged = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
if m_merged.config.num_labels != 20:
    errors.append(f"merged model num_labels is {m_merged.config.num_labels}, expected 20")
else:
    print(f"  [OK] merged model num_labels = 20")

# 4. Check detection_results.json format and content
with open("/app/detection_results.json") as f:
    results = json.load(f)

if not isinstance(results, list):
    errors.append("detection_results.json is not a list")
else:
    print(f"  [OK] detection_results.json is a list with {len(results)} items")

# 5. Check exactly 10 test samples
if len(results) != 10:
    errors.append(f"Expected 10 results, got {len(results)}")
else:
    print(f"  [OK] Exactly 10 test samples")

# 6. Check each result has required fields
required_fields = ["text", "predicted_class_id", "confidence"]
for i, r in enumerate(results):
    for field in required_fields:
        if field not in r:
            errors.append(f"Result {i} missing field '{field}'")
    if "predicted_class_id" in r and not isinstance(r["predicted_class_id"], int):
        errors.append(f"Result {i}: predicted_class_id is not int")
    if "confidence" in r and not (0 <= r["confidence"] <= 1):
        errors.append(f"Result {i}: confidence out of range")

print(f"  [OK] All results have required fields (text, predicted_class_id, confidence)")

# 7. Verify all 10 test samples are present
expected_texts = [
    "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?",
    "Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?",
    "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
    "Ciao, come stai oggi?",
    "Olá, como você está?",
    "Привет, как дела?",
    "こんにちは、お元気ですか？",
    "你好，你好吗？",
    "مرحبا، كيف حالك؟",
    "Hello, how are you?",
]
found_texts = [r["text"] for r in results]
for et in expected_texts:
    if et not in found_texts:
        errors.append(f"Missing test sample: {et}")
print(f"  [OK] All 10 expected test samples present")

# 8. Verify model uses argmax (not any hardcoded mapping)
import torch
with torch.no_grad():
    for text in expected_texts[:3]:
        inputs = m_merged.tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512)
        outputs = m_merged(**inputs)
        pred = torch.argmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1).item()
        conf = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)[0][pred].item()
        print(f"  [OK] argmax prediction for '{text[:30]}...': class {pred}, conf {conf:.4f}")

# 9. Check no stray scratch files
scratch = ["/app/setup_model.py"]
for s in scratch:
    if os.path.exists(s):
        errors.append(f"Stray file: {s}")
        print(f"  [WARN] Removing stray file: {s}")
        os.remove(s)

# Summary
print()
if errors:
    print(f"FAILURES ({len(errors)}):")
    for e in errors:
        print(f"  ✗ {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")

merged_cls = merged.classifier.out_proj.weight.clone()

# 1. All required paths exist
paths = {
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/config.json": "configured model config",
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/model.safetensors": "configured model weights",
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/tokenizer.json": "tokenizer",
    "/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/tokenizer_config.json": "tokenizer config",
    "/app/merged_model/config.json": "merged model config",
    "/app/merged_model/model.safetensors": "merged model weights",
    "/app/merged_model/tokenizer.json": "merged tokenizer",
    "/app/merged_model/tokenizer_config.json": "merged tokenizer config",
    "/app/detection_results.json": "detection results",
    "/app/build_model.py": "build script",
}
for p, desc in paths.items():
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        errors.append(f"MISSING: {desc} at {p}")
    else:
        print(f"  [OK] {desc}: {p}")

# 2. num_labels=20 in both config files
for path, desc in [
    ("/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/config.json", "configured"),
    ("/app/merged_model/config.json", "merged"),
]:
    with open(path) as f:
        cfg = json.load(f)
    nl = cfg.get("num_labels")
    if nl != 20:
        errors.append(f"{desc} config num_labels={nl}, expected 20")
    else:
        print(f"  [OK] {desc} config: num_labels = 20")

# 3. id2label has 20 entries in both
for path, desc in [
    ("/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/config.json", "configured"),
    ("/app/merged_model/config.json", "merged"),
]:
    with open(path) as f:
        cfg = json.load(f)
    n = len(cfg.get("id2label", {}))
    if n != 20:
        errors.append(f"{desc} config: {n} id2label entries, expected 20")
    else:
        print(f"  [OK] {desc} config: {n} id2label entries")

# 4. detection_results.json: list of 10 items with correct fields
with open("/app/detection_results.json") as f:
    results = json.load(f)
if not isinstance(results, list) or len(results) != 10:
    errors.append(f"Expected 10 results, got {len(results)}")
else:
    print(f"  [OK] detection_results.json: {len(results)} results")

for i, r in enumerate(results):
    for field in ["text", "predicted_class_id", "confidence"]:
        if field not in r:
            errors.append(f"Result {i} missing '{field}'")
    if "predicted_class_id" in r and not isinstance(r["predicted_class_id"], int):
        errors.append(f"Result {i}: predicted_class_id not int")
    if "confidence" in r and not (0 <= r["confidence"] <= 1):
        errors.append(f"Result {i}: confidence out of range")
print(f"  [OK] All results have required fields, correct types")

# 5. All 10 test samples present
expected = [
    "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?",
    "Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?",
    "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
    "Ciao, come stai oggi?",
    "Olá, como você está?",
    "Привет, как дела?",
    "こんにちは、お元気ですか？",
    "你好，你好吗？",
    "مرحبا، كيف حالك؟",
    "Hello, how are you?",
]
found = [r["text"] for r in results]
for et in expected:
    if et not in found:
        errors.append(f"Missing test sample: {et}")
print(f"  [OK] All 10 test samples present")

# 6. End-to-end: merged model produces predictions from scratch
m = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
m.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    for text in expected:
        inputs = t(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512)
        outputs = m(**inputs)
        pred = torch.argmax(torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1), dim=-1).item()
        conf = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)[0][pred].item()
print(f"  [OK] End-to-end inference works on all 10 samples")

# 7. Verify classifier weights are 20-class
m2 = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
w = m2.classifier.out_proj.weight.shape
if w[0] != 20:
    errors.append(f"Classifier output dim={w[0]}, expected 20")
else:
    print(f"  [OK] Classifier output dimension: {w}")

# 8. Verify LoRA was actually merged (weights differ from base)
base = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
    "FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base",
    num_labels=20,
    ignore_mismatched_sizes=True
)
merged = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
diff = (base.classifier.out_proj.weight - merged.classifier.out_proj.weight).abs().max().item()
if diff > 0:
    print(f"  [OK] LoRA merged: classifier weights differ from base (max diff={diff:.6f})")
else:
    errors.append("LoRA not merged: classifier weights identical to base")

# 9. Build script exists
assert os.path.exists("/app/build_model.py"), "build_model.py missing"
print(f"  [OK] Build script present: /app/build_model.py")

print()
if errors:
    print(f"FAILURES ({len(errors)}):")
    for e in errors:
        print(f"  ✗ {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
